title: AI SEO / AEO / GEO
description: How well the brand is understood and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): answer-ability, entity clarity, and AI visibility.

items.check: Content answers key questions directly and concisely.
items.pass_criteria: Clear, extractable answers near the top of the page.

items.check: Content uses AI-friendly structures (FAQs, definitions, lists, tables).
The brand entity is clearly and consistently defined.
items.pass_criteria: Consistent name, description, and sameAs across web + schema.

items.check: Content cites credible sources and earns citations.
items.pass_criteria: Outbound sources present; brand cited by third parties.

items.check: AI crawlers are allowed and an llms.txt exists.
items.pass_criteria: AI user-agents not blocked; llms.txt present and accurate.

items.check: Brand appears in AI answers for target queries.
items.pass_criteria: Cited/mentioned by AI engines for priority prompts.
